text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey... you know of a good napping spot
no one
else will find?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
My usual spot is currently, uh...
occupied.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There was this cat... It just looked so
comfy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean... It's first come, first serve, right?
